audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side reads 'Skill' — a flat chart — while the content layer reads Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Taliyah/Skill/Skill/Neeko. Five of seven rows disagree between the two layers the page renders.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Taliyah, Skill, Skill, Neeko], identical to content win[N], and a 61.22% win rate over 49 games supports a Neeko-favoured chart with one Taliyah window. The full-layer chart is the untouched template.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side -> Neeko, phases[3].side -> Taliyah with its why rewritten to her maxed-Q Worked Ground window, phases[6].side -> Neeko. Rows 4 and 5 correctly stay Skill.

audit.why: Levels 1-3 are yours while Threaded Volley is still 7s and she has no Worked Ground laid; 4-5 is her spike as Q maxes toward a 3s cooldown; 6 is a macro coinflip because Weaver's Wall (180s at rank 1) is a roam tool, not a duel tool; two items favour your AoE against an immobile poke champion. spikes[0..3] carry this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is named but never explained. Unraveled Earth's mines detonate and stun only when enemies DASH through them or are KNOCKED through them — that is why Seismic Shove is the setup and the E alone is not a threat. Nothing on the page says this. Also missing: Threaded Volley cast on Worked Ground consumes it for a stronger, slowing boulder, so denying her fresh ground is a real lever; and Weaver's Wall creates terrain that blocks paths.
audit.why: enemyKit E text: 'creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' E is 14s at every rank, 950 range, 90 mana. W is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8 at 900 range. Q text: 'If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows.'
audit.corrected: Stated the W-into-E stun chain explicitly, the flat 14s E, the 7s-to-3s Q ramp, and the Worked-Ground denial play.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', and breakdown.cooldowns contains no digit at all.
audit.why: Defect-catalogue item 3. Kit supplies W 14/12.5/11/9.5/8, E 14 flat, Q 7/6/5/4/3, R 180/150/120 against Neeko's 12s E.
audit.corrected: Rebuilt breakdown.cooldowns around the 14s W, the flat 14s E, and the Q ramp from 7s to 3s, with an explicit trade-early sequencing line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page treats Weaver's Wall as the map-wide roam tool it is; breakdown.feeding instead talks about the lane duel being 'over', which is not how a fed Taliyah converts.
audit.why: R is 2500/4500/6500 range on a 180/150/120s cooldown and the kit describes her surfing it. content spikes[1] and wants.you[2] already identify tracking the wall roam as the level-6 decision, but the full layer never mentions it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.feeding and breakdown.carry now key off the wall's cooldown and pinging the roam.

audit.whatIsWrong: Taliyah is female and the full layer calls her male throughout: tldr and report[0].t ('he can't afford to guess'), winCon and report[1].t ('every guess he makes'), tradeGood ('E his step-up'), ahead and report[13].t ('cost him plates'), breakdown.early ('every clone he answers wrong'), breakdown.wave and report[4].t ('near his tower'), dosFull[0].t ('Bloom his last-hit'), dontsFull[2].t and report[11].t ('his key-spell window'), report[9].t ('His answer goes first'). Separately dosFull[1].d is the tradeGood string pasted under a clone title, dontsFull[2].d is the tradeBad string, dosFull[0].d explains the shove under a title about blooming her last-hits, and dontsFull[1].d calls her an assassin.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists taliyah as female; defect-catalogue items 1 and 2.
audit.corrected: All misgendered strings rewritten or pronoun-corrected; all four mismatched bullet bodies replaced with content that matches their own titles.

notes: CHART: content win[0..6] already matches packet.levelChart exactly, so only the flat full-layer sides were moved and no no-op win[N] edits were proposed. Only phases[3] changed verdict direction, and its why was rewritten in this same proposal; rows 0-2 and 6 moved from 'Skill' to 'Neeko', which their existing Neeko-favourable whys already argue. phases[N].rating left untouched (unreadable scale). KIT FLAG CONTRADICTS RIOT TEXT: the brief flags 'grounding' on both Threaded Volley (Q) and Seismic Shove (W), but Riot's own descriptions of those abilities contain no grounding effect — per the brief's own rule I trusted the description and asserted no grounding anywhere in this audit. Nothing on the page claimed it either, so no correction was needed, but it is worth knowing before another agent 'adds' it. Also NOT asserted: whether Pop Blossom's leap counts as a dash through Unraveled Earth and detonates the mines on you. The E text says mines trigger on enemies who 'dash through it or are knocked through it' and Neeko's R carries a dash flag, but the leap lands where it starts rather than travelling through a zone, and I could not resolve it from the kits — see questionsForUser. Sample size is 49 games; the win rate is real but thin, so no rating was moved on its authority.
